rationale: Houston mean temperature (same-week 2025 anomaly) as driver vs ERCOT demand anomaly (no ERCO anomaly series exists, so anomaly transform of utility.ERCO.demand_mwh is used); the national comparison should be run as a parallel pair against utility.us.demand_anomaly, and the positive sign reflects Texas's cooling-dominated load with seasonality/winter U-shape as a confounder.
